design: plan slice 0.5 (landed on this branch): refuse any schema_version above the newest registered migration, before any statement runs
notes_for_implementer: Not a memory-library fixture: it is the database opener's test, already landed by slice 0.5, and restated here so the matrix is complete. A fresh database is created through `Database::open`, closed, its `schema_version` stamped to 99 with a plain `rusqlite` connection, then hashed and opened again. The message is verbatim from plan slice 0.5 with `<path>` the absolute path, `<n>` 99 and `<max>` the newest registered migration (42 today, 43 after 3.5); the literal `reset --factory` must not appear. The test must keep passing unchanged across 3.5, so it reads `<max>` from `migrations::MIGRATIONS.last().version` rather than a literal.
